basics.name: Chenxu Wang
basics.label: Senior Algorithm Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Algorithm Engineer at Alibaba Group working on large-scale e-commerce relevance and search. Research interests span information retrieval, large language models, knowledge distillation, and knowledge representation.

work.name: Alibaba Group
work.summary: Research and engineering on large-scale e-commerce relevance, search, and AI-driven inquiry. Building LLM-powered knowledge bases and multi-agent (sub-agent) systems, and developing interpretable relevance models via reinforcement learning and knowledge distillation from large language models.
highlights: AI Inquiry: LLM knowledge bases and multi-agent systems
